title: PAPER RIOT
hook: A giant pencil draws a trap. An ink creature turns the trap into wings.
shots: Pencil drops; Nib dodges the drawing stroke with a huge facial take.
Graphite scrape; paper slap; comic knock.
The pencil draws a door; Nib runs for it. The door grows teeth.
Drawing rasp; rushing footsteps; wood bite.
Nib yanks the edge of the page and rips a huge diagonal tear.
Long paper rip, then breath of quiet.
The torn page folds into two wings. Nib springs up.
The creature escapes its own page; paper confetti settles around a triumph pose.
Flutter, bright percussion and a soft final flap.
